# TechDiagrams - Technical Diagram Guide

Read [the owner's diagram guide](references/diagrams.md) when creating or
improving a diagram. That guide is the only file imported from Compute-AzNode;
this discovery wrapper was written locally.

Use only available, authorized tools. The guide's examples do not establish facts
about the current project or authorize access to other repositories/services.
Do not install tools, enable servers or change application behavior merely to
produce a diagram. Do not claim a render check that was not performed.
